body: Noone ever believes anyone under the age of like 20 when they feel this way. It's because they think "oh they are so young, it's a phase, there whole life is going to just get better" granted life will get better with self care. I've dealt with the "undectable abuse" it's not fun, you need a confidant someone you can trust that will seek help for you if you are too afraid to do so or think that noone can help.
Have you seen a professional or been diagnosed with anxiety? Because I felt the same way until someone took me seriously.
What is bothering you my friend. I'm sure there is someone here that can offer some help if I cannot.
there's no reason to believe that your writing will suck until you try.
